Experience with MES, PLM, and ERP systems such as Aegis, Jira, D365, Windchill or similar
Understanding of key quality metrics such as FPY, DPMO, NCR trends, Cost-of-Poor Quality (COPQ), rework rates, inspection throughput, and CAPA effectiveness

Experience supporting quality investigations, audit readiness, or continuous improvement projects
